div.div:
Escalate to tier 2 when ANY:
• tool-loop depth > 3
• input > ~6K tokens
• output needs > ~800 tokens of prose
• task ∈ {multi-step reasoning, code,
complex extraction, negotiation}
• 2 failed schema validations on tier 0
• user retried / asked "kỹ hơn"
NEVER escalate when:
• prompt carries PII → scrub or refuse
• cache hit
• budget exhausted → degrade honestly

div.div:
MiniMax-M2.5 $0.15 in / $0.90 out per M tokens
output bills ~4× input → cap max_tokens hard
stable prompt prefixes → cache reads are cheap
temperature 0.2 · top_p 0.95 for analytical work
reasoning cannot be disabled — budget for it

• no data egress — answers the

• survives an MITM-proxy block
• Vietnamese-first models beat
generalist hosted ones
• swapping tier = base-URL change
